title: Tumor-Derived Extracellular Vesicles for Noninvasive Molecular Classification of Kidney Cancer
official: Tumor-Derived Extracellular Vesicles for Noninvasive Molecular Classification of Kidney Cancer
summary: This is a correlative (lab-based) study aiming to identify protein markers in urine extracellular vesicles (EVs) that can be used to develop non-invasive molecular tests for patients with renal cell carcinoma (RCC). Aim 1 will use urine collected previously in biorepository. Aim 2 will prospectively collect blood specimens pre and post nephrectomy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Urine sample in existing biorepository
* High-risk renal cell carcinoma (RCC) per American Urological Association (AUA) guidelines
* Scheduled to undergo nephrectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Does not meet inclusion criteria
